 30.4 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, wide , that's definitely too wide of for the ump this time 30.3 Rizwanullah to Lakshya Raichandani, 1 run, shortish delivery on the off stump, Lakshya swivels and pulls to deep backward square leg 30.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, finally lays bat on the late cut, this is more of a thick outside edge that goes to third man though 30.1 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, Arjun tries to guide the ball late from a wide line outside off stump and misses for the umpteenth time. Looks like he's opening the bat face too early and every time it beats the inside half of the bat and goes to the keeper Drinks. Well done Pakistan with the ball. Amazing discipline. Actually this pitch is quite good for batting but they've bowled with a lot of control. The other factor is India have not expressed themselves as much as they would have liked to. Looks like that fear of losing wickets too early is playing on their minds again, like the league stage game. Arjun did not score a run for the first 8 balls, but he's belted a couple of sixes. This match will now be decided by him. If he gets out early, Pakistan will be extremely confident. But he faces another 40 odd balls, he could be running away with the game. Lakshya has done well to hold one end tight. Aaryavir put on a bold face, battled an injury and completed a fifty. Over 30 167-2 L1 1 1 0 6 1 ( 10 runs) Arjun Rajput 14 (14) Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani 61 (84) Mohammad Sayyam 7-0-42-0 Over Summary View all overs 29.6 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Arjun mistimes the cut to cover 29.5 6 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, SIX , my, my, my! He not only plays the pull shot well, but he plays with so much swag. Now just get out of my sight and fly over mid-wicket, he says as he smashes this short of length delivery over mid-wicket. Glove-love between the batters in the middle 29.4 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, no run, nicely played off the back foot! Short of a length delivery just outside off stump, Arjun waits on the back foot and guides to backward point 29.3 Mohammad Sayyam to Lakshya Raichandani, 1 run, Lakshya wants to drive this full delivery, mistimes. Thinks of the run and then takes off as Arjun also felt the run was on 29.2 Mohammad Sayyam to Arjun Rajput, 1 run, inside edge rolls to fine leg. Short of a length delivery on the stumps, Arjun is late on the defence and the ball escapes past the stumps 29.1 Mohammad Sayyam to Lakshya Raichandani, leg byes, again a pretty needless LBW shout. Unless the rule changes to ball pitching outside leg stump will be LBW the umpires will not give those. Short of a length delivery, Lakshya misses the pull and ball hits the thigh pad Abbas : "This is what scoreboard pressure does. RRR creeping and that will make it challenging for the batters to come." Mohammad Sayyam [6.0-0-33-0] is back into the attack Over 29 157-2 1 Wd 0 0 0 6 0 ( 8 runs) Arjun Rajput 6 (10) Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani 60 (82) Rizwanullah 5-0-24-1 Over Summary View all overs 28.6 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, short of length delivery, middles this back foot defence towards covers 28.5 6 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, SIX , struggled to connect for the first 8 balls and look at him confidently time this pull shot off the middle of the bat. Those mid-wicket deep fielders on the fence were mere spectators. Pakistan are charging in to get the dangerman early but he's made a bit of statement here 28.4 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, beaten for pace again! Slanted into the left-hander, Arjun Rajput swivels to pull and misses and gets hit on the back thigh. Rizwanullah is down on his knees to appeal for lbw but that's too high 28.3 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, slip removed and Rizwanullah bowls a short of a good length ball. Punched to point 28.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, no run, Arjun Rajput sees the width on this short of length ball and looks to cut. Correct choice but he's beaten for pace. No contact made 28.2 Rizwanullah to Arjun Rajput, wide , bouncer from Rizwanullah, Arjun Rajput ducks and that's been wided for height Rizwanullah switches to round the wicket now against Arjun Rajput. A slip in place as well 28.1 Rizwanullah to Lakshya Raichandani, 1 run, short ball, pulled through backward square leg. Not fully in control of the shot due to the bounce. 150 up for India FEATURED VIDEOS
